title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.8
body_markdown:
*released October 8th, 2024*

### What's New in this Release

* Updated the Windows 11 SDK (10.0.26100.0) installed by Visual Studio to the October 2024 servicing build.

### Developer Community

* [Refactor lightbulb doesn't show up anymore when hovering on squiggly lines](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Refactor-lightbulb-doesnt-show-up-anymo/10678772)
* [Incremental linking creates invalid dlls when header units are enabled](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Incremental-linking-creates-invalid-dlls/10688715)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-43483**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43483) .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability in System.Security.Cryptography.Cose, System.IO.Packaging, System.Runtime.Caching
* [**CVE-2024-43484**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43484) .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability in System.IO.Packaging
* [**CVE-2024-43485**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43485) .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability in System.Text.Json 6.0.x and 8.0.
* [**CVE-2024-43603**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43603) Denial of Service Vulnerability in Visual Studio Collector Service
* [**CVE-2024-43590**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-43590) Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability in Visual Studio C++ Redistributable Installer
